name: Nodevora Customer Rewards for WooCommerce
author: Ahmed ghanem

sections.description:
Nodevora Customer Rewards is a free WooCommerce loyalty plugin built for stores that want a clean and simple points system without unnecessary complexity.

Features included in this version:

  • Earn points from customer purchases
  • Redeem points for WooCommerce discounts
  • Manual points adjustments from the admin area
  • Points expiration support
  • Customer points history in My Account
  • Loyalty notices and display controls
  • Useful shortcodes for manual placement
  • WooCommerce classic and Woo Blocks support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nodevora-customer-rewards-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Nodevora Customer Rewards in the WordPress admin area and configure your loyalty settings.
  5. Test earning points, redeeming points, and the customer display flow.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Nodevora Customer Rewards works only when WooCommerce is installed and active.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. This release line is fully free.

Does it support WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes. Nodevora Customer Rewards includes support for WooCommerce block-based cart and checkout flows.
